title: Members of the Crescent City High Hatters
summary: Breaux lists the young players in his high school band and what each played.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What did they play, those different guys?

Well, Maurice and Joyce were voice alto and Tanner. Joyce played Tanner, Maurice played voice alto. Clemio Phillips played third alto. James Leysen played trumpet. Andrew Alexon played trumpet. Lionel Woods played guitar and banjo. And we had another guy now, Joe Snider. He was a trumpet player. That was Albert Snider, his nephew. He was along there with us. And Preston Gishaw, he's on trombone. Well, he's quit playing since he played until he got married.

No, that's his brother. Yeah, Preston lived right down on St. Philip Street. No, that's Skiz's brother. We call him Skiz, little Gishaw. Alfred plays alto. Skiz plays bass. You know the bass player? No, I don't know. He's one of them.
I just heard of Alfred Bill. You know?
